before and after treatment.text: all patients in the study — across 5 studies

views.caveat: Within patients with samples on both sides, before and after (egc_msk_2017: IMPACT_PRE_POST PRE-TX vs POST-TX; breast_alpelisib_2020: SAMPLE_COLLECTION_TIMEPOINT pre-treatment vs post-treatment; egc_trap_ccr_msk_2023: PRE_OR_POST_TREATMENT Pre vs Post; blca_cornell_2016: SPECIMEN_COLLECTION_PRE_OR_POST_CHEMO pre-chemotherapy vs post-chemotherapy; brca_dldccc_2022: TREATMENT_STATUS Pre-Treatment vs Post-Treatment; before and after treatment: 111 patients), per gene, among those profiled for it on BOTH sides by each side's own panels: an OncoKB driver (v7.5) on both sides, on the before side only, or the after side only; a patient with several samples on a side counts as altered there if any is. Concordance is both ÷ altered anywhere. The exact McNemar test asks whether discordance runs one way; q is Benjamini–Hochberg across the genes of each cohort. Genes were not chosen in advance: every gene with a driver in some paired patient was tested (before and after treatment: 278 genes with a discordant patient), q is taken across all of them, and the 12 most one-sided are drawn — at these sizes, read the counts, not only the q. Sides are as each study labels its samples; after-only means seen on that side and not the other, which is not proof it arose or vanished in between — a subclone one biopsy missed, or a lower-purity sample (common after treatment) under-calling its side, reads the same; and patients sampled twice are a selected group, typically with longer or harder disease courses. Counts are summed across 5 studies.

steps.title: Add each cohort's counts across its studies
Exact McNemar test per gene
steps.detail: Only the discordant patients carry information about direction: of the before-only and after-only patients, each is a fair coin under the null, so p is twice the smaller binomial tail (capped at 1). Concordance is both ÷ altered anywhere.
params: 111 patients with both kinds of sample

steps.title: Benjamini–Hochberg across genes, per cohort
steps.detail: q-values over the genes with at least one discordant patient, separately for each cohort. In a scan that is every such gene, not only the ones drawn.

steps.title: Draw the 12 most one-sided genes
steps.detail: Of the genes with a discordant patient, ordered by McNemar p, then by the size of the imbalance between before-only and after-only patients, then by the number of discordant patients, then by name; the first 12 are drawn and reported.

method.verification: The exact McNemar test matches statsmodels 0.15.0 mcnemar(exact=True) and Benjamini–Hochberg multipletests, to a relative 1e-6 (test/tables-golden.test.ts).
